# `empty-pin-connection`: Named port connection is explicitly empty / 命名端口连接被显式留空

**Severity / 严重程度:** `info`

## English

### Cause

A module instance names an input, output, or inout port but leaves the associated connection expression empty.

### Risk

An empty input or bidirectional connection can leave required behavior undefined, while unexplained open outputs make intent difficult to review.

### Fix

Connect required inputs and inouts; connect outputs when used, and clearly document any output that is intentionally left open.

## 简体中文

### 原因

模块实例写出了 input、output 或 inout 端口名称，却把对应的连接表达式留空。

### 风险

空输入或双向连接可能使必需行为未定义，而未说明的空输出也会让设计意图难以审查。

### 修复

连接必需的输入和双向端口；需要输出时进行连接，并明确说明任何有意悬空的输出。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module empty_pin_child(
  input logic enable,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o,
  inout wire data_bidir
);
  assign data_o = enable & data_i & data_bidir;
endmodule

module empty_pin_connection(input logic enable);
  empty_pin_child child (
    .enable(enable),
    .data_i(),
    .data_o(),
    .data_bidir()
  );
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module empty_pin_child(
  input logic enable,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o,
  inout wire data_bidir
);
  assign data_o = enable & data_i & data_bidir;
endmodule

module empty_pin_connection(
  input logic enable,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o,
  inout wire data_bidir
);
  empty_pin_child child (
    .enable(enable),
    .data_i(data_i),
    .data_o(data_o),
    .data_bidir(data_bidir)
  );
endmodule
```
